dex.entry: A silvery curtain-moth near the Nightreach Observatory, its wings folded like shut eyelids; at night it opens them to reveal glowing Lunar-map markings that disorient rivals. Two completely different wing faces — the shy closed moth and the revelatory open moth — give it a double life kids will find

art.silhouette: Mid-sized moth with broad flat wings folded at rest; wings are dove-grey with eyes-shut markings on the outer face, but when spread reveal detailed silver-on-indigo moonphase maps; antennae tipped with small white orbs; elegant and mysterious at 32px.
